But do you know what else gets hot?
The sand.
When the sand temperature is about 29.2 Celsius,
the number of male and female turtles
coming out of a green turtle nest will be balanced 50-50.
If the sand temperature goes up by one degree,
all the baby turtles that come out will be female.
If it goes down one degree colder,
then all the turtles that come out will be male.

the world is not getting cooler.
And scientists are finding out that in places like Malaysia,
there are almost no males hatching these days.
So when the female turtles get big enough in a couple of decades,
they may not find any males to mate with.
